export.title: Download my data
export.body: A file (.zip) with everything StreetEats keeps about you, and the photos you uploaded.

delete.title: Delete my account
delete.body: Deletes your account and everything in it for good: your business, menu, posts, photos, reviews and favorites. It can't be undone.
delete.vendorNote: If you're open, you'll be taken off the map right away.
delete.secret: Type your password or PIN to confirm
delete.done: Your account and everything in it were deleted.
